description: This Java class implements a custom Akka HTTP directive for performing Basic Authentication for specific realms related to DevOps operations. It manages development and status authentication, interacting with a configuration object for credentials and security settings.

classes.name: DevOpsBasicAuthenticationDirective
classes.description: Provides a way to perform Basic Authentication within an Akka HTTP server for DevOps-related resources, configurable with DevOpsConfig, supporting realms for devops and status endpoints.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of DevOpsBasicAuthenticationDirective with the provided configuration.

methods.name: authenticateDevOpsBasic
methods.description: Wraps an inner route with Basic Authentication logic based on the specified realm, verifying credentials via configuration and security settings.
